page.overview:
Who is Allure Queen LV5?

Allure Queen LV5 is a character version of the card, "Allure Queen LV5".

Allure Queen LV5 appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007. By beating her five times, the player gets closer to unlocking Level Four Duelists and a new Booster Pack.
